segments.ja488:1.1: Assaṃ gavaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ, bhariyañca so idha labhataṃ manāpaṃ;
segments.ja488:1.3: Puttehi dārehi samaṅgi hotu, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
segments.ja488:2.1: Mālañca so kāsikacandanañca, dhāretu puttassa bahū bhavantu;
segments.ja488:2.3: Kāmesu tibbaṃ kurutaṃ apekkhaṃ, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
segments.ja488:3.1: Pahūtadhañño kasimā yasassī, putte gihī dhanimā sabbakāme;
segments.ja488:3.3: Vayaṃ apassaṃ gharamāvasātu, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
segments.ja488:4.1: So khattiyo hotu pasayhakārī, rājābhirājā [rājādhirājā (syā. ka.)] balavā yasassī;
segments.ja488:4.3: Sa cāturantaṃ mahimāvasātu, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
segments.ja488:5.1: So brāhmaṇo hotu avītarāgo, muhuttanakkhattapathesu yutto;
segments.ja488:5.3: Pūjetu naṃ raṭṭhapatī yasassī, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
segments.ja488:6.1: Ajjhāyakaṃ sabbasamantavedaṃ [sabbasamattavedaṃ (sī.), sabbasamattavedanaṃ (pī.)], tapassīnaṃ maññatu sabbaloko;
segments.ja488:6.3: Pūjentu naṃ jānapadā samecca, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
segments.ja488:7.1: Catussadaṃ gāmavaraṃ samiddhaṃ, dinnañhi so bhuñjatu vāsavena;
segments.ja488:7.3: Avītarāgo maraṇaṃ upetu, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
segments.ja488:8.1: So gāmaṇī hotu sahāyamajjhe, naccehi gītehi pamodamāno;
segments.ja488:8.3: So rājato byasana mālattha [mā rājato vyasana’ malattha (sī. syā. pī.)] kiñci, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
segments.ja488:9.1: Yaṃ ekarājā pathaviṃ vijetvā, itthīsahassāna [itthīsahassassa (sī. pī.)] ṭhapetu aggaṃ;
segments.ja488:9.3: Sīmantinīnaṃ pavarā bhavātu, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yā ahāsi.
segments.ja488:10.1: Isīnañhi sā sabbasamāgatānaṃ, bhuñjeyya sāduṃ avikampamānā;
segments.ja488:10.3: Carātu lābhena vikatthamānā, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yā ahāsi.
segments.ja488:11.1: Āvāsiko hotu mahāvihāre, navakammiko hotu gajaṅgalāyaṃ [kajaṅgalāyaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja488:11.3: Ālokasandhiṃ divasaṃ [divasā (sī. syā. pī.)] karotu, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
segments.ja488:12.1: So bajjhatū pāsasatehi chabbhi [chamhi (sī. pī.), chassu (?)], rammā vanā niyyatu rājadhāniṃ [rājaṭhāniṃ (ka.)];
segments.ja488:12.3: Tuttehi so haññatu pācanehi, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
segments.ja488:13.3: Sakacchabandho [sakkaccabaddho (sī. pī.), saṃkaccabandho (niyya)] visikhaṃ carātu, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
segments.ja488:14.1: Yo ve anaṭṭhaṃva [anaṭṭhaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] naṭṭhanti cāha, kāmeva so labhataṃ bhuñjatañca [labhatu bhuñjatu ca (syā.)];
segments.ja488:14.3: Agāramajjhe maraṇaṃ upetu, yo vā bhonto saṅkati kañcideva [kiñcideva (ka.)].
segments.ja488:15.1: Yadesamānā vicaranti loke, iṭṭhañca kantañca bahūnametaṃ;
segments.ja488:15.3: Piyaṃ manuññaṃ cidha jīvaloke, kasmā isayo nappasaṃsanti kāme.
segments.ja488:16.1: Kāmesu ve haññare bajjhare ca, kāmesu dukkhañca bhayañca jātaṃ;
segments.ja488:16.3: Kāmesu bhūtādhipatī pamattā, pāpāni kammāni karonti mohā.
segments.ja488:17.1: Te pāpadhammā pasavetva pāpaṃ, kāyassa bhedā nirayaṃ vajanti;
segments.ja488:17.3: Ādīnavaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā, tasmā isayo nappasaṃsanti kāme.
segments.ja488:18.1: Vīmaṃsamāno isino bhisāni, tīre gahetvāna thale nidhesiṃ;
segments.ja488:18.3: Suddhā apāpā isayo vasanti, etāni te brahmacārī bhisāni.
segments.ja488:19.1: Na te naṭā no pana kīḷaneyyā, na bandhavā no pana te sahāyā;
segments.ja488:19.3: Kismiṃ vupatthambha sahassanetta, isīhi tvaṃ kīḷasi devarāja.
segments.ja488:20.1: Ācariyo mesi pitā ca mayhaṃ, esā patiṭṭhā khalitassa brahme;
segments.ja488:20.3: Ekāparādhaṃ khama bhūripañña, na paṇḍitā kodhabalā bhavanti.
segments.ja488:21.1: Suvāsitaṃ isinaṃ ekarattaṃ, yaṃ vāsavaṃ bhūtapatiddasāma;
segments.ja488:21.3: Sabbeva bhonto sumanā bhavantu, yaṃ brāhmaṇo paccupādī bhisāni.
segments.ja488:22.1: Ahañca sāriputto ca, moggallāno ca kassapo;
segments.ja488:22.3: Anuruddho puṇṇo ānando, tadāsuṃ satta bhātaro.
segments.ja488:23.1: Bhaginī uppalavaṇṇā ca, dāsī khujjuttarā tadā;
segments.ja488:23.3: Citto gahapati dāso, yakkho sātāgiro tadā.
segments.ja488:24.1: Pālileyyo [pārileyyo (sī. pī.)] tadā nāgo, madhudo [madhuvā (sī. pī.)] seṭṭhavānaro;
segments.ja488:24.3: Kāḷudāyī tadā sakko, evaṃ dhāretha jātakanti.
